2) Train from New York to Chicago same day as above.

So next Friday is May 24, 2026. Wait check days: May 17 was Friday; but that's past. Actually we need next Friday after today. If today is Saturday, then next Friday is 6 days later: May 24, 2026. Yes.

So date strings likely format like YYYY-MM-DD or maybe just month/day/year. We can use ISO format: "2026-05-24".

train_ticket_buy({"origin":"New York","destination":"Chicago","date":"2026-05-24"})

But note the function names: musical_ticket_buy expects keys: show, date. Good.

Train ticket buy expects origin, destination, date.
